bar: Build verify3 sv5_driver on box5 (Pentium T2310, SSSE3) with clang (Debian clang 19, installed at run time) at -O2 and -O3, each with the spec flags in clang spelling (-ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -std=c11 -mno-fma; -fexcess-precision=standard is gcc-only and is omitted), and with gcc 14.2.0 -O2 plus the gcc spec flags rebuilt fresh in the same run as an anchor; replay the 100 items of chunks c000+c001 of the 135M guard replay (weights = g2-135 WEIGHTS_SHA256 on box5) with each binary. MET only if all three builds (clang -O2, clang -O3, gcc -O2 anchor) give witness AND argmax digests identical to the recorded box5 reference rows for 100 of 100 items.
